result.title: Learning Spatially Aware Audio-Visual Features from Videos with Mono Audio
result.summary: Comprehensive audio-visual perception requires both semantic and spatial reasoning. Existing spatial models suffer from poor generalization due to data scarcity, while semantic-only models fail to capture spatial characteristics completely. We introduce a model capable of jointly reasoning over binaural audio and vision on semantic and spatial tasks with improved generalization. To overcome the shortage in real-world data, we develop an automatic pipeline that localizes the sound source in a video, estimates its relative 3D trajectory, and renders binaural audio. We then use this to spatialize VGGSound, allowing us to train at a much larger scale. We demonstrate improved performance and generalization on spatial reasoning tasks while still remaining competitive on semantic tasks compared to semantic-only models.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文训练一个可同时处理语义与空间任务的音视频模型：先用自动管线定位声源、估计相对 3D 轨迹并渲染双耳音频，从而大规模合成空间化数据（如 VGGSound），以缓解真实数据稀缺、提升空间任务的泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义—空间」表征的联合建模与泛化评测，可能为判断 LVR 内部状态是否保留任务必要的几何与关系信息提供参照；合成数据管线（声源定位＋轨迹标注）也可供核查能否用于几何证据类监督，但该文不涉及 latent 推理或推理期状态生成。
